input: What is the effective hard shell approval policy in this Yolop session? Inspect it through Yolop's supported configuration interface and report the value.

transcript.final_response:
The effective hard shell approval policy (`approval_policy`, aka `sandbox_approval`) in this session is **`on-request`** — the default value, unmodified from settings.

This is distinct from the soft-approval paranoia level (`approval_mode`, currently `normal`, which governs my own confirm-before-critical-action behavior). Per Yolop's config schema: `on-request` means shell execution pauses for a hard approval only when the command itself requests escalated privileges — as opposed to `untrusted` (pause before any command), `on-failure` (pause only after a command fails), or `never` (no hard pauses at all).

arguments.command: yolop config get approval 2>&1; echo "---"; yolop config get 2>&1 | head -100
